rawContent: With the whole #MeToo movement being so big right now, I’ve wanted to speak on this for a while about this but every time fear and anxiety will stop me. But I’m tired of being afraid.  There are people dying over these issues and it needs to stop.

So if there’s someone out there who’s dealt with or going through anything similar just know that what happened to you was not your fault. At all. Know that you are beautiful. You are worth it. You are loved. You are not alone. #MeToo #SAAM
